targets.target: Selmer group as the explicit restriction kernel ker(H¹(G_{F,S},M) → ⊕_v H¹(G_{F_v},M)/L_v), identified with H¹ of the imported Selmer mapping-fibre complex
targets.note: The only Selmer groups in the libraries are non-cohomological: Mathlib's K(S,n) ⊆ K^×/(K^×)^n cut out by valuations, and Tau Ceti's explicit 2-descent Selmer group of an elliptic curve in square classes of the étale algebra with local image conditions; no Galois-cohomological Selmer group, local condition or Selmer complex exists.

targets.target: Comparison of Selmer groups under a change of one local condition or the addition of a prime (exact sequences)
targets.note: Absent in both libraries.

targets.target: Selmer dimension formula (Greenberg–Wiles/Wiles formula) used in global deformation presentations and auxiliary-prime arguments
targets.note: Absent; it needs global Euler characteristics and Poitou–Tate duality, neither of which exists.

targets.target: Tangent conditions of finite-flat, ordinary and fixed-type deformation problems as local H¹ subspaces
targets.note: No Galois deformation theory (deformation functors, tangent spaces, local conditions) exists in either library.

duplicates.note: Also defines Selmer groups as kernels of the global-to-local map, proves that the Selmer mapping-fibre complex recovers the classical group, and proves changes of local conditions, overlapping R02.5's identification and change-of-condition targets.

Defines Selmer structures and Selmer groups for a general discrete Galois module as the subgroup of H¹ cut out by local conditions (Rubin I.1–2), a second carrier for R02.5's restriction-kernel Selmer group.
Constructs Selmer data from local submodules and proves a finite-level Euler-characteristic (core-rank) formula, overlapping R02.5's Selmer dimension formula.
Applies Poitou–Tate to strict/relaxed modifications at a prime, the same change-of-one-local-condition comparison that R02.5 states.
Exports the tangent condition of each local deformation condition, which R02.5 also relates to local H¹ subspaces (the document assigns the calculations to R08).

targets.target: Global numerical inequalities of KW II §4 (dimension and relation counts for global deformation problems) with infinite-place and p = 2 contributions
targets.note: Absent; neither library has Galois deformation rings or the Selmer/dual-Selmer dimension formula they rest on.

targets.target: Dual-Selmer-killing argument of KW II §5 (choice of Taylor–Wiles primes)
targets.note: Absent; no dual Selmer groups, and no Taylor–Wiles prime selection exists.

targets.target: Exact adjoint modules: ad and trace-zero ad⁰ with Galois action, their duals, and determinant-fixed tangent spaces (no identification by dividing by 2)
targets.note: Mathlib has End(V) as a representation by conjugation and the trace-zero Lie subalgebra sl_n, and Tau Ceti proves the trace form on full matrices nondegenerate; missing are the trace-zero subrepresentation of a Galois representation, its dual/Tate twist, the trace pairing on ad⁰ with its failure when p divides n, and determinant-fixed tangent spaces.

targets.target: Named finiteness, dimension and annihilator results exported for R04 and R22
targets.note: Absent in both libraries.

duplicates.note: Also states the KW II §4 lower bound on global dimension and bound on the number of relations (Prop. 4.5, Cor. 4.7), the numerical inequalities R02.6 is to prove.
Also proves the dual-Selmer dimension reduction for choosing Taylor–Wiles primes, i.e. R02.6's dual-Selmer-killing argument.
Also proves an arbitrary-n auxiliary-prime lemma with control of dual Selmer.
Also constructs the adjoint and trace-zero adjoint representations and the trace pairing with its corrections when p divides n, which R02.6 records.

GeometryOfNumbersAndQuadraticArithmetic.summary: Mathlib already contains all of GN.0 (ℤ-lattices, fundamental domains, covolumes computed through absolute determinants, and the number-field covolume 2^(−r₂)√|d_K|) and the classical core of GN.1 (Blichfeldt's theorem, Minkowski's convex-body theorem in strict and compact forms, the Minkowski bound, discriminant bounds and Dirichlet's unit theorem), together with main-term lattice-point counts; Tau Ceti adds Witt cancellation, decomposition and extension, square-class discriminants localized at the places of a number field, real and complex classification, local isotropy predicates, integral ℤ-lattices with discriminant groups, and effective class-number bounds. Genuinely missing are Minkowski's second theorem; the Witt and Grothendieck–Witt rings, Hilbert symbols, Hasse and Clifford invariants, nonarchimedean classification, Hasse–Minkowski, lattices over rings of integers with genera and spinor genera, and hermitian variants (mostly already planned by QuadraticFormInvariants and GlobalQuadraticForms); higher-rank reduction theory, representation densities, mass formulas and theta series of lattices; error terms, equidistribution and homogeneous dynamics, packing densities, Siegel's mean-value formula and Construction A; LLL with certified reductions; and all of hermitian K-theory.

targets.target: Discrete full-rank (cocompact) Z-lattices in a finite-dimensional real space
targets.note: IsZLattice (with DiscreteTopology) is a discrete Z-submodule spanning E; Mathlib proves it is free of Z-rank dim E. Cocompactness is not packaged as a CompactSpace instance on E/L, but IsZLattice.isCompact_range_of_periodic (applied to the quotient map) gives it directly.

targets.target: Fundamental domains of lattices
targets.note: The half-open parallelepiped of any Z-basis is a measure-theoretic fundamental domain for every measure, both for span-of-basis lattices and for abstract IsZLattice submodules.

targets.target: Covolume, independent of the fundamental domain
targets.note: Defined for any measure (default volume) and shown equal to the measure of any fundamental domain for an additive Haar measure; positivity is ZLattice.covolume_pos.

targets.target: Change of basis: covolumes transform by the absolute determinant
targets.note: covolume L = |det_{b0}(b)| * mu(fundamental domain of b0) for any Z-basis b and real basis b0 (and |det| of the basis matrix in R^n); there is no named lemma covolume (f L) = |det f| * covolume L for a linear automorphism f, but it is a one-step corollary of these (ZLattice.covolume_comap covers measure-preserving equivalences).

targets.target: Complex embeddings through real dimensions, with the number-field covolume factors
targets.note: The mixed space R^{r1} x C^{r2} carries the real basis (1, i) at complex places with unit fundamental-domain volume; the change-of-basis determinant is (i/2)^{r2}, and covol(O_K) = 2^{-r2} sqrt|d_K|, covol(I) = N(I) 2^{-r2} sqrt|d_K| are proved.

duplicates.note: Milestone 3A plans the Minkowski-embedding lattice/covolume API, which Mathlib already supplies.

targets.target: Blichfeldt's theorem for measurable sets
targets.note: Stated for any countable group acting measurably with an invariant measure and a fundamental domain F: if mu F < mu s for null-measurable s, two distinct translates of s meet. The lattice-point form (a nonzero difference in s - s) is not a separate named lemma.

targets.target: Minkowski's first (convex body) theorem, strict and boundary (compact, non-strict) versions
targets.note: Strict version: convex symmetric s, a countable subgroup L of E with fundamental domain F for an additive Haar measure, mu F * 2^n < mu s (no measurability assumption needed). Boundary version: s also compact, L discrete, E nontrivial, with <=. Non-full-rank lattices are excluded only through the fundamental-domain volume hypothesis; dimension zero is vacuous in the strict version and excluded by [Nontrivial E] in the non-strict one.

targets.target: Minkowski's second theorem (successive minima)
targets.note: No definition of successive minima of a convex body with respect to a lattice and no product inequality lambda_1...lambda_n vol(K) <= 2^n covol(L) (or lower bound) in Mathlib or Tau Ceti.

targets.target: Ideal-class applications: Minkowski bound, finiteness of the class number, discriminant bounds
targets.note: Mathlib proves the Minkowski bound in every ideal class, Minkowski's discriminant lower bounds (abs_discr_ge) and Hermite's finiteness from the convex-body theorem; the Fintype instance on the class group is proved by admissible absolute values instead. Tau Ceti adds the effective bound h_K <= |d_K| 4^n.

targets.target: Unit application: Dirichlet's unit theorem via convex bodies
targets.note: The unit lattice is shown to be a full lattice using convexBodyLT and the convex-body theorem, giving rank (O_K^x / torsion) = r1 + r2 - 1 and the unique decomposition into a root of unity times powers of a fundamental system (declared in namespace NumberField.Units).

duplicates.note: Ideal-class and unit applications of the Minkowski bound (effective class-number and unit-square-index bounds); completed in Tau Ceti.

targets.target: Witt theory over fields: Witt cancellation, decomposition and extension; Witt group/ring W(K) and Grothendieck-Witt ring
targets.note: Tau Ceti proves Witt cancellation, Witt decomposition (existence and uniqueness, Witt index) and Witt extension over fields with 2 invertible, and makes isometry classes of regular forms a commutative semiring under orthogonal sum and tensor product. Missing: the Grothendieck-Witt ring (group completion), the Witt ring W(K) (quotient by hyperbolic planes) and its fundamental ideal; nothing over rings or lattices.

targets.target: Discriminants of quadratic forms (square-class invariant, compatibility with sums and localization)
targets.note: Discriminant and signed discriminant in K^x/(K^x)^2 on isometry classes (char not 2), with orthogonal-sum and tensor formulas, base change, and localization at finite, real and complex places of a number field. Mathlib only has the basis-dependent Gram determinant QuadraticForm.discr with its change-of-basis formula. Discriminants of integral lattices are in Tau Ceti's IntegralLattice library.

targets.target: Clifford and Hasse(-Witt) invariants of quadratic forms in Br_2(K)
targets.note: Ingredients only: Clifford algebras (Mathlib), the Brauer group of a field as a commutative group, quaternion norm forms and splitting/Steinberg symbol relations (Tau Ceti; centrality is proved only for Hamilton quaternions). There is no quaternion symbol class (a,b) in Br(K), no Hasse or Hasse-Witt invariant and no Clifford invariant of a form.

targets.target: Local classification of quadratic forms (real, complex, nonarchimedean including dyadic)
targets.note: Real forms are classified by signature (Sylvester in Mathlib, the classification theorem in Tau Ceti) and forms over algebraically closed fields by dimension. Missing entirely: classification over nonarchimedean local fields by (dimension, discriminant, Hasse invariant), square-class counts, Hilbert symbols and the dyadic case.

targets.target: Hasse-Minkowski theorem (isotropy, representation, equivalence) over number fields
targets.note: Tau Ceti defines localizations of a form at finite and real places, the local isotropy/representation/equivalence predicates and the trivial global-to-local implications; the local-to-global theorem itself is not proved in either library.

targets.target: Hilbert symbols, real and dyadic Hasse invariants and the product formula (Hilbert reciprocity)
targets.note: No Hilbert symbol, no local Hasse invariant and no product formula over Q or a number field; Mathlib has only quadratic reciprocity for Legendre/Jacobi symbols.

targets.target: Integral lattices with forms (integral isometry kept distinct from rational equivalence)
targets.note: Tau Ceti has integral symmetric Z-lattices in rational spaces with isometries, duals, discriminant groups and quadratic discriminant forms, overlattices, even/unimodular lattices, signature and ADE/E8 examples. Missing for the local-global theory: lattices over rings of integers of number fields and over Z_p or O_v, and localization L -> L_p.

targets.target: Genera and spinor genera of lattices
targets.note: No notion of genus (local isometry at all places), no spinor genus and no finiteness of classes in a genus; only the spinor norm on Spin/orthogonal groups over a field exists in Tau Ceti.

targets.target: Quaternionic and hermitian variants of the local-global theory
targets.note: Only general sesquilinear/hermitian form and hermitian matrix API and the quaternion norm form exist; no hermitian or quaternionic-hermitian forms over local/global fields, invariants, classification or local-global principle.

duplicates.note: Witt cancellation, decomposition and extension; already built in Tau Ceti.
Discriminant and signed discriminant of regular forms; built in Tau Ceti.
Plans the Witt-Grothendieck ring and Witt ring W(K) that GN.2 'integrates'.
Plans the quaternion symbol in Br(K), Hasse and Clifford invariants.
Plans the Hilbert symbol, local Hasse invariant (dyadic included) and the Hilbert-symbol product formula.
Plans the classification of forms over nonarchimedean local fields.
Real/complex classification; built in Tau Ceti.
Localized discriminants and finite-place Hasse signs, and local classification restated at the places of a number field.
Global invariant systems with the Hasse-sign product formula and real-place invariants.
Plans the Hasse-Minkowski isotropy theorem.
Plans Hasse-Minkowski for representation and isometry.
Global classification of rational forms by local invariants.
Integral symmetric lattices with forms, isometries and signature; completed in Tau Ceti.
Dual lattices and discriminant groups of integral lattices; completed in Tau Ceti.

targets.target: Reduction domains for lattices / positive definite forms (Minkowski-Hermite reduction, Siegel domains)
targets.note: Only the rank-two case exists: the standard fundamental domain for SL(2,Z) acting on the upper half-plane with the reduction step (equivalent to reduction of positive definite binary forms). No GL_n(Z) reduction domain on positive definite forms, no Minkowski/Hermite reduced bases and no Siegel sets in higher rank.

targets.target: Arithmetic quotients with specified Haar/invariant measure and finite volume
targets.note: Mathlib has the general quotient-measure interface for G/Gamma defined through a fundamental domain; Tau Ceti proves the open standard domain is a measure-theoretic fundamental domain for PSL(2,Z) on the upper half-plane with finite volume. Missing: Haar measure normalizations on SL_n(R) or orthogonal groups, finite covolume of SL_n(Z) or O(L), and arithmetic quotients beyond SL(2,Z).

targets.target: Local representation densities
targets.note: No p-adic or real representation densities of one form by another in either library.

targets.target: Finite stabilizer weights: finiteness of automorphism groups of definite lattices and of the classes in a genus
targets.note: Tau Ceti's IntegralLattice library has isometries but no finiteness of O(L) for definite L, no class number of a genus and no weighted class sums.

targets.target: Mass formulas (Smith-Minkowski-Siegel): genus mass as weighted class sum equal to an Euler product of local densities
targets.note: Nothing towards a mass formula or Tamagawa-number statement for orthogonal groups exists.

targets.target: Theta series of lattices and their modular-form interface
targets.note: Only the theta function of the rank-one lattice Z (and the two-variable Jacobi theta) with its tau -> tau+2 and tau -> -1/tau transformations and holomorphy. No theta series of a general positive definite lattice, no modularity for Gamma_0(N) with character, no link to IntegralLattice.

duplicates.note: Plans reduction theory: Siegel sets covering arithmetic quotients and their finite volume.
Plans invariant quotient measures and Tamagawa measures, the Haar-measure normalizations GN.3 needs before a mass identity.
Plans theta series of rational quadratic data with convergence and transformation laws.

targets.target: Lattice-point estimates: counts of lattice points in dilated regions (main term vol/covol, error terms)
targets.note: Mathlib proves #(s ∩ n^{-1} L)/n^d -> vol(s)/covol(L) for bounded measurable s with null frontier (inner product space version; the general normed-space version states the limit as the volume of the coordinate image), and the analogous count of lattice points x in a cone with F(x) <= c for F homogeneous of degree d; Tau Ceti has explicit measure-free packing and doubling bounds in polydiscs. Missing: any error term (O(t^{d-1}) for Lipschitz boundaries, Gauss-circle-type bounds).

targets.target: Equidistribution of lattice points / orbits on homogeneous spaces
targets.note: No equidistribution statements (spherical, Duke-type or for expanding translates) in either library.

targets.target: Ergodicity and mixing on homogeneous spaces, unipotent flows (Ratner) and nondivergence (Dani-Margulis) for Oppenheim/Duke-type applications
targets.note: Only general ergodic theory: definitions of ergodic maps and actions, ergodicity of dense cyclic actions on compact groups and circle rotations, the von Neumann mean ergodic theorem. No Howe-Moore or mixing of flows on SL_n(R)/SL_n(Z), no Ratner theorems, no nondivergence, no Oppenheim or Duke.

targets.target: Packing and covering: lattice sphere packing and covering densities, Hermite constant
targets.note: Only metric packing/covering numbers, Delone sets with packing and covering radii, and a separated-points packing count; no packing density of a lattice, covering radius of a ZLattice or Hermite constant.

targets.target: Nonconvex star bodies (Mahler compactness, Minkowski-Hlawka) and transference theorems
targets.note: No star-body lattice problems, Mahler compactness criterion, Minkowski-Hlawka or Mahler/Khintchine transference in either library.

targets.target: Siegel mean-value formula on the space of unimodular lattices
targets.note: No space of lattices SL_n(R)/SL_n(Z) with its invariant probability measure and no Siegel integral formula.

targets.target: Lattices from codes (Construction A) connected via FF.4
targets.note: Tau Ceti has linear/additive code carriers with generator and parity-check matrices and a separate integral-lattice library, but no Construction A or code-to-lattice correspondence.

duplicates.note: Milestone 3A plans lattice-point counting with a power-saving error term for regions with Lipschitz-parametrizable boundary.
Plans counting lattice points in fundamental domains with cusp and tail estimates.
Measure-free lattice-point packing and doubling estimates; completed in Tau Ceti.
Plans Construction A lattices from codes, the lattice-code connection GN.4 lists.

targets.target: LLL-style lattice basis reduction with proven approximation factor
targets.note: Only Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization exists; no size reduction, Lovasz condition, LLL algorithm, termination or 2^{(n-1)/2} approximation bound.

targets.target: Exact change-of-basis certificates between lattice bases
targets.note: The mathematics of a certificate is in Mathlib (a family is a basis of the free module iff its determinant against a basis is a unit; transition matrices are mutually inverse). Missing: a certificate format or API tied to ZLattice and to reduction output, for number-field and arithmetic-group consumers.

targets.target: Certified short vectors: output checked in the original lattice with proven approximation factor
targets.note: No shortest-vector or closest-vector notions for ZLattice, no approximation-factor theorems and no checking interface.

targets.target: Relating lattice bounds to heights and counts
targets.note: Siegel's lemma (an explicit height bound for a nonzero vector of the integer kernel lattice), Northcott finiteness for Weil heights on number fields and asymptotic lattice-point counts exist; missing are height and counting bounds derived from reduced bases or short-vector bounds.

targets.target: Local representation tests for quadratic forms
targets.note: Only special representation theorems (sums of two and four squares); no local representability criteria for general forms over Z_p or R.

duplicates.note: Plans short-vector and closest-vector certificates on top of a verified LLL reduction.

targets.target: Exact categories with duality and symmetric/alternating forms in them
targets.note: Tau Ceti has Quillen exact structures and their opposites, but no exact duality functor with double-dual identification, and no symmetric or alternating spaces in an exact category.

targets.target: Grothendieck-Witt and Witt groups (degree zero), recovering classical forms
targets.note: Only ordinary exact K_0 and the semiring of isometry classes of regular forms over a field (char not 2) exist; no GW_0 or W_0 of a ring or of an exact category with duality, even for fields.

targets.target: Higher hermitian K-theory spaces/spectra, localization and periodicity
targets.note: Nothing on higher Grothendieck-Witt groups, Karoubi periodicity or localization sequences in either library.

targets.target: Forgetful, hyperbolic and comparison maps between K-theory and Grothendieck-Witt theory
targets.note: Only the hyperbolic form on M x M* (Mathlib) and its identification with the hyperbolic plane over rings with 2 invertible (Tau Ceti); no hyperbolic or forgetful maps between K-groups and GW-groups.

duplicates.note: Plans the Witt-Grothendieck and Witt rings of a field, i.e. the degree-zero forms case of GN.6.
